अम्बः + .{@-म्बा@} see below.

अम्बा [अम्ब्-घञ्] (Voc. अम्बे Ved.; अम्ब in later Sanskṛt)
—1 A mother; also used as an affectionate or respectful mode of address;
 ‘good woman’, ‘good mother’; किमम्बाभिः प्रेषितः; अम्बानां कार्यं निर्वर्तय
 Ś. 2; कृताञ्जलिस्तत्र यदम्ब सत्यात् R. 14. 16.
—2 N. of a plant (अम्बष्ठा d).
—3 N. of Durgā, wife of Śiva.
—4 N. of an Apsaras; of a sister of Pāṇḍuʼs mother, a daughter of Kāśīrāja.
 [She and her two sisters were carried off by Bhīṣma to be the wives
 of Vicitravīrya who had no issue. Ambā, however, had been previously
 betrothed to a king of Śālva and Bhīṣma sent her to him; but the latter
 rejected her because she had been in another manʼs house. So she came
 back to Bhīṣma and prayed him to accept her; but he could not break his
 vow of life-long celibacy, and being enraged she returned to the forest
 and practised austere penance to revenge herself on Bhīṣma. Śiva favoured
 her and promised her the desired vengeance in another birth. Afterwards
 she was born as Śikhaṇḍin^1ī, daughter of Drupada, who came to be called
 Śikhaṇḍin^2 and became the cause of Bhīṣmaʼs death.]
—5 A term in astrology to denote the fourth condition. [cf. Dravid. Amma;
 Germ. Amme; Old Germ. Amma].
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20251204. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/101.
[2] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20251204. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/101.

—1 An eye (in त्र्यम्बक).

अम्बया Ved. A mother; good woman (as a courteous mode of address).

—3 Saffron.
—4 Talc.
—5 A kind of perfume (Ambergris).
—6 Cotton. cf. अंबरं व्योम्नि वाससि । सुगन्धिनि च कार्पासे … ।

—7 N. of a people.
—8 Circumference, compass.
—9 Neighbourhood, surrounding country (Nir.) यद् वा स्थो अध्यम्बरे Rv. 8. 8. 14
—10 Lip.
—11 Evil, sin.
—12 Destroyer of elephants (नागभिद् Trik.)

—1 The offspring of a man of the Brāhmaṇa and a woman of the Vaiśya

अम्बायुः f. A mother.

—1 A mother; good woman (as a term of respect or endearment.)
—2 N. of a plant (Mar. अंबाडा).
—3 N. of the youngest daughter of Kāśīrāja, wife of Vicitravīrya^1.
 She became the mother of Pāṇḍu by Vyāsa who was invoked by Satyavatī
 to beget a son to Vicitravīrya^2 who had died without issue.

अम्बिः f. Ved. Water; woman; nurse; mother; अम्बयो यन्त्यध्वभिर्जामयो
 अध्वरीयताम् Rv. 1. 23. 16.

—1 A mother, good woman, also used like अम्बा as a term of respect
 or endearment; अत्तिके अम्बिके शृणु मम विज्ञप्तिम् Mk. 1.
—2 N. of a plant (अम्बा 2); N. of another plant कटुकी.
—3 N. of Pārvatī, wife of Śiva; आशीर्भिरेधयामासुः पुरः पाकाभिरम्बिकाम् Ku. 6. 90.
—4 N. of the middle daughter of Kāśīrāja and the eldest wife of Vicitravīrya.
 Like her youngest sister she had no progeny, and Vyāsa begot on her a
 son named धृतराष्ट्र.
—5 Name of a Jaina deity.
